faq.q: Is Ladner farmland the same market as East Delta?
faq.a: On this page, yes in practice: the live ladner-farms feed carried both Ladner Rural and East Delta sub-area listings, and both sit under the same rules — Delta's Official Community Plan Agriculture (A) designation and A1 zoning where the zone applies.

faq.q: Can a Ladner-area farm have a second dwelling?
faq.a: Yes, within limits: Delta's A1 zone permits one accessory farm dwelling unit per lot — 90 m² or less on lots of 40 ha or smaller, 186 m² or less on larger lots — on the same farm home plate as the farm house; more than one needs Agricultural Land Commission approval, and an additional farm house needs an agrologist's necessity report plus written ALC approval.

faq.q: Can I subdivide a Delta farm parcel?
faq.a: Only within tight limits: in the A1 zone a new lot created by subdivision needs a minimum of 8 ha, Official Community Plan compliance and Agricultural Land Commission Act approval where applicable, with a home site severance exception under ALC policy.
